data.name: Mirajul
data.gender_notes: Mirajul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit roots 'mi' (moon) and 'rāj' (delight). The name Mirajul signifies the joy or delight that the moon brings. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a symbol of peace, tranquility, and calmness. The name Mirajul carries the meaning “Moon's delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mirajul usually hope their child will grow to embody moon's delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your life be filled with the calmness and serenity of the moon.
data.etymology: Mirajul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon's delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mirajul total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: Mirajul is a Hindi name that combines the beautiful and calming significance of the moon. It is a unique name that adds to the richness of Indian culture by preserving the ancient and deep-rooted connection to lunar deities. This name holds a sense of joy, peace, and tranquility, representing the calmness of the night and the inner peace it brings.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context of Hinduism, the name Mirajul holds immense significance as it relates to the divine power and influence of the moon. It is believed that the moon has the power to heal, regenerate, and renew. Individuals with this name are thought to embody the tranquility, peace, and calmness associated with the moon. They are also thought to have the ability to inspire joy and delight in others around them. This spiritual significance encourages individuals to live in harmony with the cycles of nature, maintaining the peace and tranquility within themselves and their surroundings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mirajul: Radiant in the court of the Divine. Shining with the inner light of spiritual knowledge and devotion.
